decision: Complete release is not strictly sequence-disjoint. Potential curated fungal transfer panel only after frozen-candidate protocol, taxon/ON-OFF mapping, reference-semantics and licensing review; do not turn the nonmatching remainder into an automatically independent test.
limitations: Sequence overlap disproves strict sequence disjointness; absent exact matches do not establish family or taxonomic independence.
Matching records count every candidate occurrence, not only distinct sequences; identifier renaming cannot hide sequence reuse.
No labels or predictions are examined; this does not validate the reference classification or score orthology accuracy.
AA.fsa is a combined release file; one archive FASTA member does not establish one species or a complete species inventory.
HTTP checksums identify the snapshot but do not authenticate its origin; raw third-party sequence bytes are not committed.
CGOB reference semantics, taxon synonyms, ON/OFF eligibility and redistribution permissions are not admitted by this exposure-only audit.

Primary development datasets, complete exposed YGOB AA input and all registered fixed/variable simulation inputs are checked. This is not a claim that every historically inspected file has been audited.
No orthology labels, predictions, alignments or gene trees were downloaded/read; candidate selection must not use this audit as accuracy evidence.
